about: T-492 (C-223): a daemon GIVEN, nothing back. DEBUG -> GAME EVENTS -> A GIFT ARRIVES writes what the companion writes (GIFTED, bit 11 of 0x1E, with TRADED_IN, partner 0) on a THEOREM from TRADER, and runs the load-time finish: the line says it arrived as a gift, it trade-evolves to LEMMA MIND as a received daemon does, and FIRST MET says A GIFT. THEOREM and LEMMA MIND (national 67, 68) are first made unseen on the scratch save -- the INDEX byte holding 65-72 zeroed in all four copies and their FIRST MET bytes cleared -- because T-479 records FIRST MET only for a species never seen. The theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's.

stops.stop: T-492: A GIFT ARRIVES -- the line, and LEMMA MIND in slot 6
T-492: LEMMA MIND's and THEOREM's area pages -- FIRST MET: A GIFT
steps: shot LEMMA MIND's area page: FIRST MET
shot THEOREM's area page: FIRST MET
